Name: JP's Ultra Giant Crops
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=6][i][u][b]
Ultra Giant Crops[/b][/u][/i][/size][/color][/font][/center][font=Georgia]


[size=5][b][i][color=#ff00ff]Because if they can be giants, nothing stops them from being even bigger, right? I still remember my uncle's last words, “Don't touch that pumpkin, you idiot!” and that's when the giant pumpkin rolled over and crushed him. Tragic. [/color][/i][/b]
[/size]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]This mod simply allows giant crops to grow larger, requiring their respective space (4x4 to 15x15). All crops in the area must be mature and ready to harvest. Even if you don't harvest them, every day they have a chance of becoming giant. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Crops are more likely to be 3x3 than 15x15 [i][b][color=#ffff00](VERY UNLIKELY).[/color][/b][/i][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=3][b][i]The mod is compatible with any plant or mod that adds giant crops! Like 6480's mod. [/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Giant crops yield 15% more crops and increase in quantity as they grow larger, but they also become harder to break. Prepare that axe for a great battle.[/size][/font]
[/list][/font][font=Georgia]


[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]That's it, the mod doesn't modify anything about the crops, it simply takes the original sprite and enlarges it to match the custom sizes, as well as changing the maximum number of items dropped and the life it can have. It supports both square (such as 5x5) and rectangular (such as 2x3) sizes, and they grow linearly. [/i][/b][/size][/color]
